en.title: MCMC Settings and Convergence of CMSY++ Runs
en.description:
This function shows how the Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) of each CMSY++ run was set up and
whether its chains converged. CMSY++ fits its Bayesian state-space Schaefer model with JAGS
(Plummer 2003), here with the settings `n.chains`, `n.iter`, `n.burnin` and `n.thin` (see
`cmsy_defaults()`; CMSY++16.R uses 2 chains of 60,000 iterations, the first 30,000 discarded
as burn-in and every 10th kept). `cmsy_run()` keeps the draws of each chain of the main
parameters; nothing of the model is changed.
en.details:
For r, k, MSY (r k / 4, as CMSY++16.R computes it), B/k in the first and last years, B/Bmsy
and F/Fmsy in the last year and the deviance, the function gives the posterior mean, standard
deviation and 95% interval, the potential scale reduction factor Rhat of Gelman and Rubin
(1992), computed with `coda::gelman.diag()`, and the effective sample size of all chains
together, computed with `coda::effectiveSize()` (Plummer et al. 2006). Rhat compares the
variance between chains with the variance within chains; values near 1 mean the chains have
mixed: a parameter is taken as converged when Rhat is at most `rhat_max` (1.1, Gelman et al.
2013). The effective sample size is the number of independent draws the autocorrelated draws
are worth; below `n_eff_min` (400, Vehtari et al. 2021) the 95% limits are imprecise. With the
settings of CMSY++16.R the draws of r and k are strongly autocorrelated, and their effective
sample size is often a few hundred; longer and more chains raise it, e.g.
`cmsy_run(settings = list(n.chains = 4, n.iter = 300000, n.burnin = 150000, n.thin = 50))`,
which takes about five times as long. Converged chains do not mean that the priors or the model
fit the stock.

With `plot = TRUE`, a chart of each stock shows the draws of each chain in the order they were
kept (trace) and their densities, for r, k, MSY and the last-year B/k, saved as
`figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/mcmc.png`; it is also the "mcmc" chart of `cmsy_plot()`.
en.value:
Invisibly, a list with `settings` (one row per stock: `n_chains`, `n_iter`,
`n_burnin`, `n_thin`, `n_kept` per chain and `n_draws` in all), `diagnostics` (one row
per stock and parameter: `mean`, `sd`, `lcl`, `median`, `ucl`, `rhat`, `n_eff`,
`converged` (Rhat at most `rhat_max`) and `enough_draws` (effective sample size at least
`n_eff_min`)) and `plots` (the ggplot objects).

arguments.stocks:
Optional stocks: `Stock` identifiers or species, by English or Chinese FAO name,
scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code. Default is NULL, all stocks that ran.
arguments.rhat_max: Largest Rhat taken as converged. Default is 1.1.
arguments.n_eff_min:
Smallest effective sample size (all chains together) taken as enough. Default
is 400.
arguments.plot:
A logical value. If TRUE (default), the trace and density chart of each stock is
saved in `figures/png/cmsy/<stock>/`.
arguments.table:
A logical value. If TRUE (default), the two tables are saved in `tables/cmsy/`
(`mcmc_settings.csv` and `mcmc_diagnostics.csv`).
arguments.colors:
Colours of the chains in the chart: NULL (default) for the colour-blind safe
Okabe-Ito colours (blue, vermilion, green, ...), the name of a palette (any palette of
`fao_settings(palette = )`, e.g. "npg", "Set1", "Tableau 10" or "viridis"), or a vector
of colours, one per chain (e.g. `c("black", "#D7191C")`); with fewer colours than
chains, colours are interpolated.
arguments.lang:
The language of the chart text and parameter names: "en" (English), "zh"
(Chinese) or "both". Default is NULL, the language set with `fao_settings()`.
arguments.pptx:
A logical value. If TRUE, the charts are also saved as editable PowerPoint files.
Default is the value set with `fao_settings()` (FALSE unless changed).
arguments.plot_show:
A logical value. If TRUE, each chart is also drawn in the plot window (e.g.
the Plots pane of RStudio) as it is saved, to look at it at once. Default is FALSE,
which can be changed for all functions with `fao_settings(plot_show = TRUE)`. The
charts are saved as files (`plot = TRUE`) either way.
arguments.silent:
A logical value. If FALSE (default), the stocks and parameters that did not
converge or have too few effective draws are reported. Default can be changed with
`fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`.

zh.title: CMSY++运行的MCMC设置与收敛诊断
zh.description: 该函数显示每次CMSY++运行的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）是怎样设置的，以及各条链是否收敛。CMSY++用JAGS（Plummer 2003）拟合贝叶斯状态空间Schaefer模型，所用的设置是`n.chains`、`n.iter`、`n.burnin`和`n.thin`（见`cmsy_defaults()`；CMSY++16.R默认2条链，每条迭代60,000次，前30,000次作为预烧舍弃，之后每10次保留1次）。`cmsy_run()`保存主要参数每条链的抽样，模型本身不作任何改动。
zh.details:
对r、k、MSY（按CMSY++16.R的算法为r k / 4）、第一年和最后一年的B/k、最后一年的B/Bmsy和F/Fmsy以及偏差（deviance），函数给出后验均值、标准差和95%区间，Gelman和Rubin（1992）的潜在尺度缩减因子Rhat（用`coda::gelman.diag()`计算），以及所有链合计的有效样本量（用`coda::effectiveSize()`计算；Plummer等，2006）。Rhat比较链间方差和链内方差，接近1说明各条链已经混合：Rhat不超过`rhat_max`（1.1，Gelman等，2013）时视为收敛。有效样本量是自相关的抽样相当于多少个独立抽样；低于`n_eff_min`（400，Vehtari等，2021）时，95%区间不够精确。按CMSY++16.R的设置，r和k的抽样自相关很强，有效样本量常常只有几百；加长链并增加链数可以提高有效样本量，例如`cmsy_run(settings = list(n.chains = 4, n.iter = 300000, n.burnin = 150000, n.thin = 50))`，运行时间约为原来的五倍。链收敛并不说明先验或模型适合该种群。

`plot = TRUE`时，每个种群画一张图，按保留顺序显示每条链的抽样（轨迹）及其密度，参数为r、k、MSY和最后一年的B/k，保存为figures/png/cmsy/<种群>/mcmc.png；这也是`cmsy_plot()`的"mcmc"图。
zh.value: 以不可见方式返回一个列表，包含`settings`（每个种群一行：`n_chains`、`n_iter`、`n_burnin`、`n_thin`、每条链保留的抽样数`n_kept`和抽样总数`n_draws`）、`diagnostics`（每个种群每个参数一行：`mean`、`sd`、`lcl`、`median`、`ucl`、`rhat`、`n_eff`、`converged`（Rhat不超过`rhat_max`）和`enough_draws`（有效样本量不少于`n_eff_min`））以及`plots`（ggplot对象）。

arguments.stocks: 要显示的种群（可选）：种群代码，或物种的英文名、中文名、学名或FAO三字母代码。默认为NULL，即所有运行过的种群。
arguments.rhat_max: 视为收敛的最大Rhat。默认为1.1。
arguments.n_eff_min: 视为足够的最小有效样本量（所有链合计）。默认为400。
arguments.plot: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，把每个种群的轨迹与密度图保存在figures/png/cmsy/<种群>/。
arguments.table: 逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，把两张表保存在tables/cmsy/（mcmc_settings.csv和mcmc_diagnostics.csv）。
arguments.colors: 图中各条链的颜色：NULL（默认）为色盲友好的Okabe-Ito配色（蓝、朱红、绿……）；也可以是调色板名称（`fao_settings(palette = )`支持的任何调色板，如"npg"、"Set1"、"Tableau 10"或"viridis"），或每条链一个颜色的向量（如`c("black", "#D7191C")`）；颜色少于链数时按插值补足。
arguments.lang: 图表文字和参数名称的语言："en"（英文）、"zh"（中文）或"both"（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即`fao_settings()`设置的语言。
arguments.pptx: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，图表还另存为可编辑的PowerPoint文件。默认为`fao_settings()`中的设置（未更改时为FALSE）。
arguments.plot_show: 逻辑值。为TRUE时，每张图在保存的同时也画在绘图窗口中（例如RStudio的Plots窗格），便于立即查看。默认为FALSE，可以用`fao_settings(plot_show = TRUE)`为所有函数统一更改。无论是否显示，图表都会保存为文件（`plot = TRUE`）。
arguments.silent: 逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，报告未收敛或有效样本量不足的种群和参数。可以用`fao_settings(silent = TRUE)`更改默认值。
